}

# Define a constant for the default PHP version
DEFAULT_RELEASE_VALUES_PHP_VERSION = '8.1'

# Function to determine the live MW image version based on the selected PHP version and environment
def mediawiki_image(environment):
    # Retrieve the release values file path for the selected PHP version
    release_values_file = RELEASE_VALUES.get(DEFAULT_RELEASE_VALUES_PHP_VERSION)
    
    # Replace the '{environment}' placeholder with the actual environment name
    release_values_file = release_values_file.format(environment=environment)
    
    # Read the release values file and determine the live MW image version
    with open(release_values_file, 'r') as file:
        release_values = yaml.safe_load(file)
        live_image_version = release_values['main_app.image']
    
    return live_image_version

local function getEntityStatements(entity, propertyId, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    local statements = entity.claims[propertyId]

    if propertyId and statements then
        local originalStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        for _, statement in ipairs(statements) do
            if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
                statement["qualifiers"] = nil
                statement["references"] = nil
            end
        end

        local cloneOfStatements = mw.clone(statements)

        if qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled then
            for cloneKey, cloneOfStatement in ipairs(cloneOfStatements) do
                cloneOfStatement["qualifiers"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["qualifiers"]
                cloneOfStatement["references"] = originalStatements[cloneKey]["references"]
            end
        end

        return cloneOfStatements
    end

    return statements
end

local function updateStatementTable(actualStatementTable, key, value, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    local statements = getEntityStatements(actualStatementTable[key], key, qualOrRefUsageTrackingEnabled)
    if statements then
        actualStatementTable[key] = statements
    else
        actualStatementTable[key] = value
    end
end
